_aspect: null fills the window body, as 2.5.0 did. Pin a number (16/9 = 1.778) only if a show needs a guaranteed frame shape.
_note: Per-show config (§2.6). A show declares what it needs, so a show without face recognition never loads it. This is the one structural idea from 2.5.0 that worked well and carries over directly. Step 1 registers no capabilities at all, so this list is empty and the page loads zero models.
title: demo
_paper: Show-wide paper defaults (§2.3). paper.cut drives HANDS (colour segmentation), paper.face drives FACE PARTS (landmark contour), with paper.eye / paper.mouth overriding per part. No live texturing — it was measured as the dominant per-frame cost.
_panelTab: Label for the panel’s title tab. Omit it entirely on a performance rig — you do not need to be told it is a control panel.
